key_insight: Agent4FreeFem turns natural-language topology optimization problems into verified results through LLM-driven execution and automated, constrained code repair.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets expert-intensive solver development and debugging that slow topology optimization workflows in aerospace, automotive, and mechanical engineering.
method: Preserve the original problem definition throughout the pipeline.
Localize errors using independent sources of evidence.
Automatically apply constrained repairs within stage-specific budgets.
evidence_signal: Across a suite of single-physics and coupled multiphysics problems, every case passed runtime verification and completed within each stage’s repair budget.
watch_item: The abstract does not report benchmark size or verification criteria, so runtime success alone should not be equated with physical correctness or design optimality.
paper_title: Agent4FreeFem: A Verification-Guided Framework for Autonomous Topology Optimization
